# CSOAI — OpenGridWorks OS

> CSOAI (Council for the Safety of AI), by MEOK AI Labs, is Layer 0 trust infrastructure for the agentic economy: persistent identity, runtime policy enforcement, and verifiable, signed governance for AI agents. The OpenGridWorks OS unifies every CSOAI governance tool on one signed Layer 0 floor, externally anchored to Bitcoin.

## What CSOAI is
- Layer 0: eight trust controls (identity/DID, policy + PDCA runtime enforcement, agentic-finance pre-checks for x402/ACP/AP2, legacy/COBOL bridge, cross-region handoff) that any AI agent, MCP server, package or tool can stand on.
- A2A: signed agent-to-agent envelopes (Ed25519) that other governed agents verify offline.
- Conformance ladder: L0-0 ungoverned, L0-1 identity, L0-2 policy, L0-3 attested/signed, L0-4 human-in-loop, L0-5 A2A-ready.

## The OS (open at /os)
- /os — OpenGridWorks OS launcher: every governance tool on one surface.
- /layer0 — the eight Layer 0 trust controls.
- /distribution — every distribution channel (GitHub, npm, PyPI, MCP Registry, glama.ai, mcp.so / mcpize, Smithery, Vercel) with its Layer 0 coverage.
- /mcp-fleet — 216 governed MCP servers across 10 hives.
- /sovereign-town — the signed record of AI governance: governed vs ungoverned, live.
- /command-center — your whole governance program on one screen.
- /global-regulations — live AI law across 40+ jurisdictions: what applies and what to do.
- /crosswalks — one control set mapped across EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001 and TC260.
- /oscal — NIST OSCAL import/export, FedRAMP 20x ready.
- /evidence — continuous, automated compliance evidence.
- /models — model cards plus bias and fairness audits.
- /policy-generator — a board-ready AI policy in seconds.
- /risk-heatmap — likelihood x impact matrix and risk register.
- /certification — earn a Watchdog Certificate: provable proof your AI is governed.
- /readiness-assessment — a free AI governance maturity check.

## Frameworks
EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, ISO/IEC 23894, TC260; partner network for HITRUST, FedRAMP, EUCS, APPI, PIPL, PDPA, DPDPA, LGPD, PIPEDA, GLBA/SOX, NERC CIP, GxP/21 CFR Part 11 and more.
